# configs/

`config.json` files of public Hugging Face model repositories (architecture and size fields only: no weights, no
code), used by the memory-estimate, archspec and planner tests. They come from each model's public repository and
remain under that repository's licence (see its model card); a few are hand-edited variants of a public config to
cover quantisation and speculative-decoding layouts. Remove a file on request.
